caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular textile-like design divided vertically into two equal halves. On the left side, the background is a dark blue color with a light beige, stylized symmetrical tree in the foreground. The tree’s branches and leaves are evenly distributed, and circular shapes are scattered among the foliage. Its trunk is straight, splitting into two main branches, and the tree is flanked by two vertical rectangles topped with circles. Below the tree is a horizontal fence design composed of a grid of small squares, ending on each side with a rectangle and a circle. At the bottom is a horizontal border with a pattern of interlocking diamonds in alternating dark blue and light beige. The right side mirrors the left, but the colors are inverted: the background is light beige, and the tree, fence, and decorative border are dark blue. The symmetry and repeated motifs define the composition, with the tree being the central object in each half, placed above the same supporting base and border pattern.
title: Tyler Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
